lines.text: Many learners say: Always I drink tea in the morning.
Better: I always drink tea in the morning.
The second! I always eat fish.

data.wrong: Always I drink tea in the morning.
data.right: I always drink tea in the morning.

native.tip: نقول «دائمًا أشرب الشاي»، أما هنا فتأتي always بعد I: “I always drink tea in the morning.” وليس “Always I drink tea in the morning.”

en.tip: In Arabic we say «دائمًا أشرب الشاي», but here always comes after I: “I always drink tea in the morning.” not “Always I drink tea in the morning.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “Always I drink tea in the morning.” 😅 In Arabic we say «دائمًا أشرب الشاي», but here always comes after I, so the right sentence is “I always drink tea in the morning.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
